Implement SPEC.md sections 3.1 (address search and on-chain resolution), 3.4, 3.5, 4.11, 7.2 and 7.3. Copy the Intake ABI from https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-1811-build-technical-foundation-hooks/blob/46e17ea70534e8a7ac2c4ff78501a3c183d32da8/docs/checks/consolidated/sources/intake-abi.json into src/abi/intake.json. With viem public clients over https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com and https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com, read Requested logs from the Intake 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82 filtered to the launch.open@launch-1 action id in 10,000-block ranges walking backwards with an in-memory and localStorage cache; decode the body JSON; keep univ4_hook bodies and evm_contracts bodies whose objective mentions Uniswap v4 hook; read Completed logs for those ids; status 0 with an ipfs uri fetches https://ipfs.imd.fun/ipfs/<cid>/result.json for the launch addresses; status 1 or 2 is Failed with the bytes32 reason decoded as ASCII. Merge over public/launches.json; chain data wins. For every payer address, try an ENS reverse lookup on Ethereum mainnet (cached in localStorage for a day) and keep the name for the featured strip and the hook page. Mark cards Built here when the objective ends with the fixed sentence from 5.1; derive block labels by matching numbered rules against the catalog sentence templates, falling back to Custom. Search: a 40-hex query matches hook, token, distributor or pool currencies of known launches; a 64-hex query matches request ids and transaction hashes; an unmatched address is resolved on the three chains as in 3.1. Hook page at #hook/<chainId>/<requestId> per 3.4 with the Owner controls panel (rows from the owner functions of the hook's matched blocks, enabled only when the connected wallet equals owner(), OPEN FORM for functions with arguments, one field per argument, address validation) and the Traders, anyone, and readings panel (public and user functions as buttons, views read on load and every 20 seconds); build the minimal ABI from the 4.11 signatures. My hooks per 3.5 with a MANAGE link for live hooks (connected wallet from job 4 may be absent: accept the address from a query param for now). Pond trigger: poll both chains every 20 seconds for new Requested logs with the launch action and call the cast function with the name parsed from the first line of the objective, else A new hook was requested on <chain>. Tests: decoding fixtures captured from at least two real Requested and two Completed logs on each chain saved under tests/fixtures, one Live case with a real result.json fixture, one Failed case, address resolution against a known hook and a known token on a fork, a Manage panel test on a fork with a mock hook exposing pause() and paused(); Playwright for the Hook page at three widths. Deliver source, dist/ and test results. When a matched block has a risk field (SPEC 4.13), show the same small warning sign with its tooltip next to the block label on the hook page.
